label: Bible Study
prompt: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and _____ shall be increased.
verse: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.
note: Seal the book until the end — when many will run to and fro and knowledge will grow.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And all nations shall call you _____: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the LORD of hosts.
verse: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the LORD of hosts.
note: Malachi's promise after the tithe challenge: all nations shall call you blessed — a delightsome land.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the _____, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
verse: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
note: The KJV's 'doctors' were teachers of the law — and twelve-year-old Jesus sat among them asking questions.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the _____ trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
verse: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
note: Peter's realism: fiery trials aren't a sign God lost the plot — they're the refiner at work.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let not _____ come out of your mouth: for the LORD is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.
verse: Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth: for the LORD is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.
note: Hannah's song warns the proud: let not 'arrogancy' come out of your mouth — the KJV's longer cousin of arrogance.
